twists.name: Heatwave
twists.line: Heatwave. The machines are sweating. So am I. Mostly because of you.

twists.name: Rush order
twists.line: Rush order from upstairs. Bigger quota, faster line. What could go wrong?

twists.name: Inspection day
twists.line: Inspection day. Complaints hurt more, and everything looks suspicious.

twists.name: Power flicker
twists.line: The power is flickering. Everything will stop for a moment. Don't panic. Panic a bit.
